content.title: 2021 ESC Guidelines for the diagnosis and treatment of acute and chronic heart failure - Reviewers
content.note: Report lists declarations of interest as reported to the ESC by experts during the yearly call for declaration covering the previous calendar year (calls conducted during development of these guidelines up to and including 2020).
